parsed.explanation: Combined regime has tier-1 universal exposures: national binary passport rule allowed by Supreme Court Nov 2025, federal facilities by birth sex, and border cable directing refusal on document discrepancy with possible fraud ineligibility. This state's school/college facility law is birth-certificate based but has no criminal penalty or enforcement mechanism and no documented arrest under it; adult visitors are less exposed than students. No trans-specific criminalisation, execution, or routine police detention is documented, and courts have enjoined several orders, hate-crime and employment protections exist, and 33 local ordinances bar discrimination. Custody abuse and prison conversion policies raise severity if detained. Litigation uncertainty and state tightening keep it below reduced-risk, but absence of imprisonment for presence keeps it above severe detention regimes.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary sex passport rule; border cable instructs refusal where discrepancy casts doubt, possible lifetime fraud ineligibility if wilful misrepresentation found. State Aug 2026 MVA announcement restricting markers to M/F.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; fraud finding never automatic, requires four elements, limited waivers; passport policy litigated; foreign governments issued advisories.
entry_documents.interaction: Home/foreign passport discrepancy can trigger secondary screening, refusal, and wider investigation, but waiver/litigation and consular avenues are documented.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National prison policy from 2026 mandates conversion practices, hair cutting, hormone removal; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary, sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No documented routine detention of visitors for presentation; courts have blocked several orders; legal aid and ACLU litigation documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Detention is not the documented first response to entry discrepancy, but if custody occurs, birth-sex placement and reported abuse increase severity.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal binary facility bar; state Protect All Students Act requires K-12 and college public/private facilities by birth certificate, single-occupancy exempt; national map shows bans in many states.
federal_state_facilities.protection: State act has no enforcement mechanism or criminal penalty and no documented arrest under it; national map notes 29 states plus capital have no mapped ban.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Adult visitor mainly faces federal/government-building exposure; minor/student faces state school/college designation. Single-occupancy exemption limits some exposure.

care_services.exposure: State under-18 puberty blocker/hormone/surgery ban enacted 2024; national orders restrict minor care and funding, though several enjoined. Adult visitor care not documented as barred.
care_services.protection: Care/sports bill blocked Apr 2024, allowed Aug 2024, re-enjoined Mar 2025; adult proposed perpetual counselling rules dropped Feb 2024.
care_services.interaction: Minor traveller care/sport status is uncertain and must be checked; adult continuity of hormones not documented as seized at border.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National orders frame sex as binary at birth, remove gender-identity workplace policy, investigate schools, ban trans athletes; 2025 poll: 66% support assigned-sex documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No trans-specific criminal offence documented in this state; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity; employment sex-discrimination ruling 2018/2020.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing raises outing and discretionary enforcement risk, while functioning courts and injunctions limit some measures.

minors_guardians.exposure: School/college facilities by birth certificate; Jan 2025 law requires staff to out LGBTQ students to parents and bans undefined gender ideology K-3; care and sports bans may affect enrolment.
minors_guardians.protection: Facility law has no penalty/enforcement mechanism; care/sports bill re-enjoined Mar 2025, operative status unresolved; single-occupancy restrooms exempt.
minors_guardians.interaction: Parent/guardian of minor could face outing, facility refusal, and uncertain care/sport eligibility during longer stays; short-stay adult exposure lower.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state anti-discrimination statute for private employment/housing/public accommodations; ambient hostility documented in poll and national arrest example under another state's trespass bathroom law in 2025.
street_violence_police_response.protection: 2018 state executive order bars gender-identity discrimination in state employment; 33 cities/counties bar discrimination in employment, housing, public accommodations; national hate-crime law.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Local ordinances may protect in covered cities, but uneven coverage and thin state recourse leave street harassment less remediable elsewhere.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit, executive-order challenges, and care/sport bill status unresolved; county birth-certificate refusals continue; July 2026 tiering methodology not sourced.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have granted relief historically: 2020 birth-certificate ruling, several orders blocked/enjoined, legal-aid FAQ on documents.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies exist but timing and current enforceability are uncertain, so traveller cannot rely on prompt relief during a short visit.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.35-B where police routinely stop, confiscate documents and detain for hours; here border refusal is possible but routine visitor detention and fines for presentation are not documented.
Similar to 0.55-B: extended secondary screening on document discrepancy, discretionary refusal/return rather than prosecution, slow written remedies, and high officer discretion.
Lower than 0.75-C where matched passports are accepted and detention ends with counsel, reasons and compensation; here national binary rule and refusal cable create a known universal exposure.

Higher than 0.25-C where birth-sex prison housing with frequent assault and slow remedies is central; here custody abuse is reported nationally but not shown as routine for visitors, and state facility law lacks criminal penalty.

parsed.synthesis: The operative interaction is document discrepancy at entry or in a federal facility leading to refusal or birth-sex placement, not routine arrest for appearance. State school/college rules add exposure for minors/students without criminal penalty. Courts, local ordinances, hate-crime law and injunctions provide partial recourse, but the November 2025 passport ruling, unresolved care/sports injunction, and national custody-abuse reports keep severity material. Hence elevated risk, near the 0.55 administrative-exposure anchor.
